text.text: Villingili became Kolige Resort, the second resort in the Maldives after Kurumba Village.
Kolige Resort closed, and Villingili was resettled to ease overcrowding in Malé.
Villingili became Malé’s fifth administrative district, and was renamed Villimalé.
The Thilamalé bridge is being built, linking Malé, Villimalé, Gulhifalhu and Thilafushi.
